title: Comparative Effectiveness of Unilateral vs. Bilateral Pulmonary Collapse in Cardiac De-airing
brief_summary: To compare the effectiveness of unilateral pulmonary collapse (right lung) to bilateral pulmonary collapse for cardiac de-airing in open left-sided heart surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aortic valve pathology requiring surgery.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior thoracic surgery,
* Severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease and/or
* Emphysema.
